inspection.method: Read the actual retained historical primary PDF pages and visually inspected the startup page/table rendering. Exact SHA retained in source_access.json.
inspection.scope: 8.4.4.1–8.4.4.2/Table8-1, printed8-20–8-22/PDF276–278: low4KiB startup page, vector, INIT/SIPI sequence and acknowledgement; 8.4.5, printed8-23/PDF279: APIC ID identification versus initial IDs; 9.8.5–9.8.5.3, printed9-11–9-12/PDF323–324: PAE, CR3, EFER.LME, paging, identity mapping, descriptor and interrupt-transition requirements
inspection.limits: Historical selected passages only, not current CPU errata. The original teaching adapter uses one SIPI with no retry; the typical two-SIPI sequence and physical timing remain separately identified limitations.

inspection.method: Read actual private primary PDF text at the specified pages and visually inspected rendered Figure3.3/3.2.2. Fresh URL open timed out; the already-local document was read and hashed.
inspection.scope: 3.2.1–3.2.2, printed15–16/PDF16–17: preserved registers, direction flag, stack alignment and red zone; 3.2.3 passing rules and Figure3.4, printed20–21/PDF21–22: scalar INTEGER argument registers and register preservation

resources.reason: Separate ISA transition requirements, selected scalar ABI, C synchronization and emulator capability observations.

inspection.method: Opened and read actual official QMP page sections, including full-expansion environmental caveats and unavailable-features semantics; not just search snippets.
